item.title: Chicago Partners with Local Organizations - Hubbard Broadcasting
item.description: The city and surrounding metro area of Chicago is a bustling city full of amazing people and great opportunities. We have partnered with organizations and created infrastructure within our own organization to give back to this great community.

item.title: Hubbard Employees Volunteer in Duluth - Hubbard Broadcasting
item.description: Duluth, Minnesota holds a special place in our hearts. We got our start here in Minnesota and we want to give back to the community that helped us become the company that we are today.

item.title: Cincinnati Gives Back - Hubbard Broadcasting
item.description: In Cincinnati we are dedicated to our local community. From volunteering with children to giving to those in need, we get involved at every level of this vibrant city.

item.title: Hubbard Helps the Twin Cities - Hubbard Broadcasting
item.description: Since 1923, Hubbard Broadcasting has proudly served as a pillar in the Minneapolis-St Paul communiy. We strive to find ways to give back to this beautiful community.

item.title: Hubbard Helps Inform and Educate our Chicago Listeners - Hubbard Broadcasting

item.title: Hubbard Radio North Helps Local Businesses - Hubbard Broadcasting
item.description: Many businesses are suffering due to being closed or having customers shelter in place during this current pandemic.
